_comment: Configuration for tools/harness/static_checks.py.
Edit this file, not the script, when the site legitimately gains a new
external origin or a new public contact address.

public_contacts._comment: Addresses that are SUPPOSED to be on a public professional site. Anything else that looks like an email is reported.

_comment: Every non-local origin the SHIPPED pages may reference.
'assets' = origins that serve CSS/JS/fonts into the page and therefore see
every visitor's IP address on every page load. Keep this list as short as
possible; index.html dropped Google Fonts in Aug 2026 for exactly this reason.
'links' = destinations a visitor only reaches by clicking. These cost the
visitor nothing until they choose to go.

tracker_signatures._comment: Substrings that indicate an analytics/telemetry beacon. None of these belong on this site.

_comment: Author/committer identities allowed to appear in git history.
A personal mailbox in commit metadata is permanently public once pushed:
GitHub serves it via the .patch endpoint and the commits API to anyone.
Prefer the GitHub noreply address.
Pages whose local asset links carry a ?v= cache stamp. The harness asserts
that (a) each page uses ONE stamp value, and (b) the stamp changed whenever
the bytes behind it changed. README.md warns that a stale stamp serves
returning visitors a broken mix of old and new files.
Scripts that import a sibling under a ?v= query count too (glob patterns
allowed): every simulation imports ./_shared.js that way.
The site's own public origin. Absolute URLs pointing here are resolved
back to local files, so an og:image referenced as a full https:// URL
still counts as 'referenced' and is still checked for existence.

expected_unreferenced._comment: Files that are deliberately in the tree without being wired up. Each needs a reason.

paths.assets/profile/jihun-chae-master.jpg: Master source image. tools/build-profile-images.py derives the shipped .jpg/.webp/-og.jpg from it, and tools/build_og_card.py renders the -card.jpg link preview around it.
paths.assets/project-library/bookshelf-og.png: Bookshelf link-preview image. Unused while BOOKSHELF_ENABLED is false in index.html; kept for when the bookshelf is switched back on.

ignore_paths._comment: Not part of the shipped site; excluded from reference and PII scans.
